study_identification_part.si_4_title: Regional, circuit and network heterogeneity of brain abnormalities in psychiatric disorders

nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: We then trained a normative model based on hierarchical Bayesian regression (HBR), fitted separately in each region... to establish a normative GMV range given an individual's age, sex and scan site
